# Legacy Linux source build fixtures

These exact files come from commit `a1ddfe3199ede2b788a407b329231ec3534feac6`, before the portable macOS build assets. Their SHA-256 values are asserted by `rsi-build.spec.ts` and match the production legacy receipt allowlist.

Keep the bytes unchanged. Tests read these fixtures directly so exported source archives need neither Git history nor a `.git` directory. The fixture scripts are not executed or published.
